2117029899449913398.en_summary: In The Stolguard Incident and other fiction I'm writing, I tend to be in a transitional camp. I explore deeply gray and disturbing areas, acknowledging major ethical complexity, but with themes that point toward virtue rather than nihilism.
2117029899449913398.zh_summary: 在我正在撰寫的《The Stolguard Incident》及其他小說中，我傾向處於過渡陣營。我深入探索灰色與令人不安的領域，承認重大倫理複雜性，但主題指向美德而非虛無主義。

2117028806469058667.en_summary: The S&P 500's earnings boom is simply unprecedented this late into an economic cycle. Profits are on pace to surge 35% this year followed by another 15% gain expected in 2027. That would be 55% growth in just 2 years.
2117028806469058667.zh_summary: 標普 500 的盈利增長在經濟週期如此後期實屬空前。今年利潤預計將激增 35%，2027 年再預期增長 15%。兩年內將增長 55%。

2117026847871381507.en_summary: S&P 500 equal-weight beat the S&P 500 cap-weight by 5.9% in October. That is the second largest outperformance ever, with only April 2009 larger. April 2009 wasn't the worst time for investors.
2117026847871381507.zh_summary: 標普 500 等權重在 10 月超越市值權重 5.9%。這是史上第二大的超額表現，僅次於 2009 年 4 月。2009 年 4 月並非投資者最差的時期。

2117025153611636822.en_summary: Does a weekly signal catch a five-day panic? The live answer from March 2023: no. SVB, Mar 8 to Mar 13: S&P 500 -3.4%, long Treasuries +3.94%. The JOJO.Index stayed in high yield and matched it at -1.08%. Credit-off weeks: 0 of 2.
2117025153611636822.zh_summary: 每週信號能否捕捉五天恐慌？2023 年 3 月的實時答案：不能。SVB，3 月 8 日至 13 日：標普 500 -3.4%，長期國債 +3.94%。JOJO.Index 維持高收益並以 -1.08% 匹配。信用關閉週：0 之 2。
